plateNote: Room 2's plate under operation 1's light (tools/art/room36-dawn.py), so every rect is Room 2's, read off the same pixels; the dog's is where he lies on his back.

scaling.note: ROOM 2 DECLARES ITS OWN DEPTH, from its own architecture. height = 0.369 x (y - 300), anchored on two measurements of the plate that agree to the pixel: the saloon porch deck is 40px for about 0.6m and its batwing doorway 134px for about 2.0m, and both imply a 1.75m man at 117px at the building line. Errata 54’s shared zones (222/240/263) belong to Room 1, whose street is shallower; applying them here puts a man at 1.66 times the height of the door he walks through. Doc 36 Q10.
